proposals.old: `(x ↦ T, Γ)` for "update the partial function `Γ` so
proposals.new: `x ↦ T ; Γ` for "update the partial function `Γ` so
proposals.why: The ::::terse note gives a different context-update notation, `(x ↦ T, Γ)` (comma, parens), than the one actually used everywhere else in this chapter (the ::::full note and the real HasType definition both use `x ↦ T ; Γ`, semicolon, no parens). A TERSE-only reader would see a notation that never appears again in the chapter's own code. Align the TERSE wording to the real notation.
